title: Dulce base shootout in Lazar's briefing documents

tellings.quote: the the idea that there had been this shootout down below in in a base at Dulce and that 64 special forces guys got killed because they had arms and they were not allowed to have arms and the gray shot them

plain: An underground base at Dulce, New Mexico, is said to have been the scene of a shootout in which 64 special forces soldiers were killed by grays, the big-eyed, gray-skinned beings of many alien accounts, because the soldiers had brought weapons they were not allowed to carry. The researcher Grant Cameron says this story was in the briefing papers that Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at S-4, a secret site near Area 51 in Nevada, says he was given to read there. Cameron sums it up without naming any further source, and if true it would mean a deadly clash between humans and aliens took place on American soil.
